```{r general setup, include = FALSE, eval = !params$run.pipeline }

source( "01_Input_general.R")
source( paste0( path.utils, "utils_preprocessing.R" ))

```


```{r optional setup, include = FALSE, eval = !params$run.pipeline }

### Peaktable

path.peaktable.pos <- NULL
path.peaktable.neg <- NULL

peaktable.sep <- ";"
peaktable.sample.pattern <- ".mzML.Peak.area"

mz_col_nr <- 2
rt_col_nr <- 3
identity_col_nr <- 4


### Peak cleaning setup

# Feature filtering
bl.thres <- c( 3, "BL", "<", "PO100")            # 3, mean in PO should be > 3 times BL
rsd.po.thres <- c( "PO100", "<", 50)        # 50, RSD in PO should be < 50%
rt.range <- c(0, 30)         # c(0, 30), only keep peaks in 0 - 30 min
mean.thres <- list( c( "PO100", ">", 1, "PO25"),
                    c( "PO25", ">", 1, "PO12.5")
              )

# Filter based on missings
filter_by_missing_feature_pct <- 50

# Missing imputation
missing.impute.method <- "HF"  # "LoD", "HF", "median", "min", "mean"

```


```{r set path, include = FALSE}

path.output <-
  paste0(params$path.result, "04_Clean_peaktable/")

if (!dir.exists(path.output)) dir.create(path.output)

if (is.null(params$path.peaktable.pos) | is.null(params$path.peaktable.neg)){

  params$mz_col_nr <- 2
  params$rt_col_nr <- 3
  params$identity_col_nr <- 4
  
}

if (is.null(params$path.peaktable.pos)){
  
  params$path.peaktable.pos <- paste0(params$path.result, "03_03_Preprocessing/peaktable_targeted_pos.csv")
  
}

if (is.null(params$path.peaktable.neg)){
  
  params$path.peaktable.neg <- paste0(params$path.result, "03_03_Preprocessing/peaktable_targeted_neg.csv")
  
}

```

### POS
#### 1 Data import
```{r data import pos, eval = params$run.pos}

if ( grepl(".xlsx", params$path.peaktable.pos) ){
  
  peaktable <-
    readxl::read_excel( params$path.peaktable.pos )
  
} else {
  
  peaktable <-
    read.csv( params$path.peaktable.pos, 
              sep = params$peaktable.sep, 
              check.names = FALSE)
  
}

print("POS peaktable was imported from the following file:", quote = FALSE)
print(params$path.peaktable.pos, quote = FALSE)

peaks.names <-
  paste0(params$sample.info.pos$Sample.name, params$peaktable.sample.pattern)
 
peaks.all <-
  cbind(peaktable[, c(params$mz_col_nr, params$rt_col_nr, params$identity_col_nr)], peaktable[, peaks.names])

peaks.temp <-
  peaks.all %>%
  dplyr::rename( mz = 1,
                 rt = 2,
                 Identity = 3) %>%
  mutate(  Identity = if_else( grepl(": 0.", Identity, fixed = TRUE),
                               substr(Identity, 1, regexpr("\\:[^\\:]*$", Identity)-1),
                               Identity),
           Identity = ifelse( is.na(Identity),
                             paste0(round(mz, 3), "_", round(rt, 3)),
                             Identity ),
          Feature.id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Identity) %>%
  mutate( n = n(), 
          Identity = ifelse( n > 1, 
                             paste0(Identity, "-iso", row_number()),
                             Identity)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Feature.id) %>%
  select( -c(n, Feature.id) )

peaks.is <-
  peaks.temp %>%
  filter(substr(Identity, 3, 3) == ".")

peaks <-
  peaks.temp %>%
  filter(substr(Identity, 3, 3) != ".")
  
```


#### 2 Feature filtering
```{r filtering, eval = params$run.pos}

mzrt.filtered <-
  filter_peaks( peaktable = peaks,
                sample.type = params$sample.info.pos$Sample.type,
                bl.thres = params$bl.thres,
                rsd.po.thres = params$rsd.po.thres,
                rt.range = params$rt.range,
                mean.thres = params$mean.thres)

peaks.filtered <- 
  mzrt.filtered$peaktable


features <- 
  cbind( peaks.filtered[, c("mz", "rt", "Identity")], mzrt.filtered$summary[, -1])

data <- 
  t(peaks.filtered[, !colnames(peaks.filtered) %in% c("mz", "rt", "Identity")]) %>%
  as.data.frame()

colnames(data) <- features$Identity

```


#### 3 Filter based on missings
```{r filter, eval = params$run.pos}

# By feature
feature_filter <- 
  filter_by_missing( data, 
                     method = 'feature',                        #feature or sample
                     threshold = params$filter_by_missing_feature_pct  #Percentage
  )

data <- feature_filter$x
features <- features[feature_filter$index, ]

```

#### 4 Missing imputation
```{r impute, eval = params$run.pos}

data.impute <- 
  impute_various_methods( data,
                          method = params$missing.impute.method
  )

data <- data.impute$x

```

```{r export, eval = params$run.pos}

### Prepare feature info

peaktable.cleaned <-
  cbind( features[, c("mz", "rt", "Identity")], 
         t(data)) %>%
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate( Identity = strsplit( Identity, "-iso")[[1]][1] ) %>%
  group_by(Identity) %>%
  mutate( n = n(), 
          Identity = ifelse( n > 1, 
                             paste0(Identity, "-iso", row_number()),
                             Identity)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select( -n )

peaktable.cleaned <-
  rbind(peaktable.cleaned, peaks.is)
        
output.file <- paste0(path.output, "peaktable_targeted_pos_cleaned.xlsx")

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "peaktable")
writeData(wb, "peaktable", peaktable.cleaned)
addWorksheet(wb, "features")
writeData(wb, "features", features)
saveWorkbook(wb, file = output.file, overwrite = TRUE)

print( paste0("POS cleaned peaktable was saved as: ", output.file ), quote = FALSE)

```
